frames.label: The EUR discount curve sells off through the belly
SOFR shifts up two basis points
The meeting dated curve reprices the front end
The EUR discount curve gaps again
The EURIBOR basis widens a basis point and a half

stressScenarios.name: Parallel +100bp
stressScenarios.note: Every curve up one hundred basis points at every tenor

stressScenarios.name: Parallel -100bp
stressScenarios.note: Every curve down one hundred basis points at every tenor

stressScenarios.name: Steepener
stressScenarios.note: Front end down 20bp at two years and in, long end up to +40bp at thirty years, on every curve

stressScenarios.name: Flattener
stressScenarios.note: The steepener reversed: front up 20bp, thirty years down to -40bp, on every curve

stressScenarios.name: Basis widening
stressScenarios.note: Projection bases up 15bp (EURIBOR, BBSW) and cross currency bases up 25bp; discount curves unmoved

stressScenarios.name: AUD +50bp
stressScenarios.note: Every AUD curve up fifty basis points; nothing else moves
